items.title: How to deliver facilitated planning in this practice
items.whyItMatters: The strategy works in a trial (claim c2), but the practice does not know whether its vets can deliver it, which farms will take part, or whether gains last.
items.opportunity: Study reach, fidelity, adoption and maintenance of planning visits in the practice's herds.

items.title: Adoption measured by farmer report
items.whyItMatters: Reported isolation was double the observed rate (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Observe a fixed set of measures at baseline and six months.

items.title: Small and tenant farms
items.whyItMatters: Farms without spare housing or labour may be unable to adopt isolation (claim c1) and could be left out.
items.opportunity: Record farm size and tenure and include low-cost priorities for small farms.

items.title: Herd numbers and timeframe not yet known
items.whyItMatters: The need did not give the number of client herds.
items.opportunity: Count client dairy herds before planning recruitment.

errorsFound: The need assumes farmers ignore advice through indifference; the retrieved evidence points to generic advice, housing and labour.
reevaluation: The practice should test how to deliver facilitated planning with its own vets, measuring observed adoption, rather than re-test whether planning works.
summary: Four gaps; delivery in this practice and observed measurement are high severity.
